run_metadata.coverage_summary: Discovery performed via WebSearch (extended mode) only. This cloud session's network policy blocks direct page fetches: WebFetch returns getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND for every non-allowlisted host (re-confirmed this run against https://www.tenders.gov.au/atm; egress proxy permits only package registries, GitHub and Anthropic endpoints). No tender detail page, portal listing or specification document could be opened, so ALL findings are HEADLINE level only - deliverables, requirements, evaluation criteria, documents, values and contacts are null/empty and every tender is counted in entries_pending_detail. Tier 1 covered across all nine jurisdictions: Commonwealth (AusTender - Defence LAND 6504 air defence EOI), NSW (buy.nsw - FAFT panel, Transport for NSW Future Fleet Horizon 1 train EOI, HealthShare NSW patient transport + continence industry briefing, Sutherland Shire minor works panel), VIC (Buying for Victoria - Ports Victoria, Box Hill Institute, HealthShare Victoria, State Library Victoria, Gippsland Water, Victoria Police, CFA), QLD (QTenders/VendorPanel - Energy Queensland, TMR reseals + Inter-CAD, Brisbane City Council, Queensland Health RBWH), WA (Tenders WA - Water Corporation, East Metro Health, WA Police x2, DFES, DoTMI, DMPE, South Metro TAFE; WAPHA own page), SA (SA DIT via aggregator), NT (QTOL - DLI road/weed/traffic works), ACT (Suburban Land Agency, weak coverage). Tier 2 sampled universities (ANU, Uni Canberra, USC) and health/GBE buyers. Tier 3 (mandatory) checked: SAP Business Network Discovery, BHP/Rio Tinto/Fortescue, EstimateOne/Arete - no publicly-visible corporate RFx found (all registration- or invitation-gated); recorded at portal level only.
gaps: WebFetch blocked for all non-allowlisted hosts (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND) - no tender detail pages or specification documents could be opened; every tender is headline-level only. Resolving this requires allowing tender portal domains in the session network settings.
AusTender (tenders.gov.au) could not be fetched directly; the single Commonwealth item (Defence LAND 6504) came from a trade-news article citing the notice and is unverified against AusTender.

QTenders (Queensland) and SA Tenders/Buying4SA official listings did not appear in search results; QLD and SA items were surfaced via aggregators (Helm, TenderHub, GovMarket) as discovery signals and point to the buyer-originated portals, but closing dates are not verified against the official notices.
Tasmania (Tenders Tasmania): no reliable open November 2026 opportunities could be confirmed via search; deferred.
ACT (Tenders ACT): only a single Suburban Land Agency item with a closing date was visible; title/ID not captured. Weak coverage this run.
Local government / VendorPanel: no live aggregated public-tenders list was accessible; only individual council pages surfaced. Broader council sampling deferred.

Tier 3 corporate (SAP Ariba Discovery, BHP, Rio Tinto, Fortescue, Woolworths, Coles, EstimateOne): no publicly-visible open RFx; opportunities are registration-gated or invitation-only. Recorded at portal level only, no individual corporate opportunities captured (none fabricated).

University items (ANU, Uni Canberra, USC) came from the australiantenders.com.au aggregator; the dates may be publish rather than closing dates and are unverified against the universities' own notices.
recommended_seed_additions: Cook Shire Council (QLD) - VendorPanel public tenders (new this run)
Arete - subcontractor tenders via EstimateOne (new construction head-contractor source this run)
